floater.name: wolf_skis
floater.title: Winter Fun
floater.text: Slide down the snowy hills. The steeper the slope, the faster you go.

button.label: Skis
button.name: skis_btn
button.tool_tip: A pair of skis and poles. You stand on them.

button.label: Snowboard
button.name: board_btn
button.tool_tip: A snowboard. You stand sideways on it.

button.label: Sledge
button.name: sledge_btn
button.tool_tip: A wooden sledge. You sit on it and lean to steer.

button.label: Snow disc
button.name: disc_btn
button.tool_tip: A round snow disc. You sit on it; it turns slowly round as it slides.

button.label: Put them on
button.name: put_on_btn
button.tool_tip: It appears at your feet and you are on it. Your free ones are in your inventory, under Objects.

button.label: Get off
button.name: take_off_btn
button.tool_tip: Stand up. It goes back to your inventory, ready for next time.

button.label: Show the Ski HUD
button.name: show_hud_btn
button.tool_tip: Bring back the HUD across the bottom of the screen.

check_box.label: Show the Ski HUD while I ride
check_box.name: hud_auto
check_box.tool_tip: Speed, steepness, your run time, jumps and style points across the bottom of the screen.

floater.string: Put my skis on
Put my snowboard on
Get on my sledge
Get on my snow disc

Nothing moves until you press an arrow key. Left / Right arrow: turn. Down arrow: slow down and stop. Up arrow: push along on the flat. E: jump. C: crouch to go faster. In the air, Left / Right spins you round.

Nothing moves until you press an arrow key. You stand sideways. Left / Right arrow: turn. Down arrow: slow down and stop. Up arrow: push along on the flat. E: jump. C: crouch to go faster. In the air, Left / Right spins you round.

Nothing moves until you press an arrow key. Only the arrow keys are used. Left / Right arrow: lean to steer - it turns in a wide curve. Down arrow: heels in the snow to slow down and stop. Up arrow: push along on the flat. Bumps throw you in the air by themselves.

Nothing moves until you press an arrow key. Only the arrow keys are used. It turns slowly round as it slides. Left / Right arrow: lean - it drifts a little that way. Down arrow: hands and heels in the snow to slow down and stop. Up arrow: push along on the flat. Bumps throw you in the air by themselves.
You are on your skis. Point them downhill and press an arrow key!
You are on your snowboard. Point it downhill and press an arrow key!
You are on your sledge. Point it downhill and press an arrow key!
You are on your snow disc. Press an arrow key and off you go!
You are on your skis. Press an arrow key to go - the keys are above.

You are on your snow disc. Press an arrow key to go - the keys are above.
